On Wed, May 26, 2027 at 09:12 AM Samantha King <samantha.king@helixparts.com> wrote:
> We just tried to accept the supplier invite you sent for HelixParts and the activation link returns a '403 — SAML assertion expired' page (screenshot attached).

Triage notes (summary of log attached as sso_saml_response.txt):
- The SAML assertion's NotOnOrAfter timestamp is 2027-05-26T16:22:00Z; HelixParts' assertion shows 2027-05-26T16:15:00Z. Our gateway rejects when assertion time is in the past relative to gateway clock.
- There's ~7 minute skew between Okta timestamp and our gateway. Normally we tolerate a 120s skew; this exceeded that and caused the 403.

Options:
1) Reissue invite link with a fresh assertion/token (fastest; 5–10 minutes).
2) Perform manual activation in the supplier admin console (requires an audit entry; low risk and immediate).
3) Temporarily increase allowed clock skew to 10 minutes on the auth gateway — this requires a small configuration change and a safe rollout (30–45 minutes) and will affect other tenants.

My recommendation: reissue the invite and, while Helix accepts, file an ops ticket to raise the skew allowance for a short window if we see repeated failures. I've opened OPS-523 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-523) to track the gateway skew config change.

Attachments: sso_saml_response.txt (sanitized), link to OPS ticket.

Ben Carter
